name: Right of reply
about: An ASSAY finding names your asset or feed, or an ASSAY contract verdict (free or paid) named your contract, and you want to respond
title: "[Right of reply] <finding id or contract address>"
---

<!-- How this works, including how a correction is made: docs/RIGHT-OF-REPLY.md -->

**Finding id**: the last part of the finding page's URL. For
`https://assay-steel.vercel.app/f/CRWD-share-count` it is `CRWD-share-count`.

**Or, if a contract verdict named your contract** (the free MCP verdict or the paid $0.25 audit),
which has no public page or id: the contract's address on Robinhood Chain (4663).

**Who you are** (and your relationship to the named contract or integration). A signed message
(EIP-191) from the contract's deployer or owner is accepted as attribution; paste it here if you
have one.

**Your reply**, published verbatim and unedited:

<!-- Write freely. ASSAY does not trim, summarise or rebut inside your text. -->

---

**Are you asking for a correction?** (yes / no — if yes, say what is wrong)

**Should your reply be published?** (yes / no — for a contract named only in a contract verdict,
publishing it names that contract, so nothing is published unless you say yes)

**Do you want it published without linking to this issue?** (yes / no)
